newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Busang j/v to issue statement later Mon.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Busang j/v to issue statement later Mon.

text.p: Indonesian Busang Gold JV, which planned to develop the now discredited Busang property in East Kalimantan province, will issue a statement on Monday, the public relations company hired by the consortium said.

"We will issue a statement tonight," the spokeswoman from PT Mecurindo said when contacted to comment on the announcement by Bre-X Minerals Ltd that its claims about the Busang gold discovery were based on falsified data.
Bre-X has a 45 percent stake in the consortium, Freeport McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc has 15 percent, while Indonesian interests hold the remaining 40 percent.
The spokeswoman said the consortium had obtained a copy of the independent audit carried out by Canadian consultant Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd.
Strathcona said in an interim report released in Canada on Sunday that an "economic gold deposit has not been identified in the southeast zone at the Busang property, and is unlikely to be".

Bre-X stunned the mining world last month when it said it might have overestimated the amount of gold at Busang, originally estimated at almost 71 million ounces which would have made it the biggest find of the century.
